definition.label: Connect physical pieces
definition.description: One connection component for fixed joins, rotating hinges and bounded sliders. Configure saved local frames without moving; attach creates a fixed join at the two CURRENT poses while physics is paused; align explicitly moves the owner to its connected frame (angle must be zero for fixed joins). The slide operation explicitly aligns a slider at distance within its saved limits. Slider distances, target and speed use connected-object local metres along its frame +X; world distance/speed scales with that object. Spring gains are N/m and N*s/m; force caps drive force in N. Motor uses damped velocity control and can stall under load. Owner needs solid/bouncy physics; the other member may be fixed. Zero breakForce/breakTorque means unbreakable; positive limits are newtons/newton-metres. A PhysX break releases the body, emits object.connection.broken and stays broken through pause/resume. Rearm requires the exact members already aligned and clears only the live break latch; it does not save, teleport or add Undo. Configure/attach/align/slide save once with one live-pose Undo and explicitly reset break state after successful persistence. Remove releases the component. Failed edits leave the original poses/connection. Connected-body collisions are suppressed; other collisions remain. Missing, misaligned or animation-owned members freeze the owner. Sixteen total connections, one outgoing link per creation, no cycles. Frames use +X as hinge axis and +Y as zero direction. Scaling/teleporting can require repair. Break state is runtime play state, not a saved damage field: workspace reload reconstructs the saved definition and still requires alignment. No automatic socket search, welding mesh merge or guessed identity. Temporary saved edits stay in their fork.

definition.label: Live sliding distance
definition.description: Signed anchor distance along the connected frame +X, in connected-object local metres. Unavailable unless the slider and exact other object are loaded. Read object.connection.state to distinguish active, paused or broken; a distance alone does not prove a press or contact cause. Use ordinary condition waits with separate press/release thresholds for hysteresis.
